satellites.title: When a Measure Becomes Ordinary
satellites.evidence: 尋常 has an ordinary or commonplace sense and an older connection with length measures. The historical route needs checking before any etymological conclusion.

satellites.title: Searching for the Ox
satellites.evidence: The first of Kuoan’s Ten Oxherding Pictures is 尋牛, searching for the ox. The series runs from seeking the ox to forgetting both ox and self, an empty circle, and then returning to the marketplace.
satellites.caveat: The ox is commonly read as one’s own mind or nature, a reading the pictures invite but do not state. Baracus’s, from general knowledge.
